address: 226/9 Mu 1, Soi Mae Nam 5, Mae Nam, Ko Samui, 84330, Thailand
bio: Prioritising flavour over fuss, this modest spot has championed Thai and Southern Thai seafood for over 50 years. Fresh local catch is cooked to order, delivering bold, soothing tastes in highlights such as black pepper crab, stir-fried prawns and traditional steamed fish. Fairly priced, generous portions thrive in a simple, air-conditioned, no-frills interior, with the Southern yellow curry of giant sea catfish roes and taro stems proving truly irresistible....
